variants.headline: Home world raises its demands
variants.body: The home world has raised what it demands of the colony. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: A larger claim on the colony
variants.body: The demands placed on the colony by the home world have increased. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: Distant authority asks for more
variants.body: The home world is demanding more from {colony}. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.
